tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List all ChangeGamer resources with metadata and absolute URLs. Returns slug, title, description, category, tags, updated date, premium flag, and HTML/Markdown/JSON variant URLs. No body content. Optional `category` and `premium` filters narrow the list; without them every resource is returned.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Fetch a ChangeGamer resource by slug. Free resources return full metadata, the Markdown body, cited source URLs and a ready-made citation/bibtex. Premium resources require a valid api_key; without one a payment-required object is returned. An unknown slug returns did_you_mean suggestions.

tools.name: get_access_info
tools.description: Return current access and pricing information for ChangeGamer resources.

tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search the ChangeGamer corpus by keyword. Every word must match the title, tags, category, description or (as a last resort) the body; results rank title > tags > category > description > body, the same order as the site search. tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return the full paid-offer catalog: every tier with price, currency, interval, checkout URL, what it unlocks, deliverables, and license grant — plus the free layer and premium slug list. Same data as /api/pricing.json.

tools.name: get_payment_info
tools.description: Return the agent payment manifest: every way to pay (HTTP 402 + Bearer key, MCP, Stripe checkout, x402, RSL per-crawl), the exact 402 retry loop, what is always free, and the recommended path per use case. Same data as /api/payment.json.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Return corpus stats: total/free/premium counts, per-category counts, tag count, newest/oldest update dates, the 10 most recently updated resources, feed URLs — plus an editorial block (guide count, words, newest publish) merged at runtime from the static articles index. A small freshness/size signal

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List ChangeGamer editorial guides (always free, separate from the licensable corpus): compact rows (slug, title, cluster, kind, order, description, updated, Markdown URL), one page at a time, plus the cluster list. `cluster` narrows to one topic; `full: true` returns the complete index with search i

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one ChangeGamer guide (editorial article) by slug as full Markdown with its metadata header, plus a second JSON block with the canonical URL, citation/bibtex and the reference resources it builds on. Always free — never part of the paid corpus. Use list_articles or search to discover slugs.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search across ALL ChangeGamer content (resources and editorial guides), ranked like the site search: every word must match; title hits weigh most, then tags, category, description. tools.name: get_cluster
tools.description: Fetch one ChangeGamer guide cluster (topic bundle) from the free editorial layer: cluster metadata, every member article as a compact row with its Markdown URL, and the pillar’s full Markdown body. Use list_articles to discover cluster ids.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_resources, get_resource, search_resources, get_corpus, get_pricing, get_stats, list_articles, get_article, search, get_cluster, check_access · Private data: get_corpus, get_full_corpus · Public sink: get_stats, check_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_resources, get_resource, search_resources, get_corpus, get_pricing, get_stats, list_articles, get_article, search, get_cluster, check_access · Private data: get_corpus, get_full_corpus · Public sink: get_stats, check_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_resources" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
